good.headline: CCC Intelligent Solutions agrees to $6.1 billion take-private deal with GTCR, Elliott - Reuters
good.plain: A big company wants to buy CCC for a lot of money, which could make the stock price go up.

good.headline: A $7.75 cash payment for each share would go to CCC shareholders if the sale closes. - Stock Titan
good.plain: If the deal happens, each shareholder would get $7.75 in cash for every share they own.

good.headline: Stock Market Today, Oct. 12: CCC Intelligent Solutions Surges 8% on Advanced Buyout Talks - The Motley Fool
good.plain: The stock jumped 8% because people think the company might be sold soon.

good.headline: Strength Seen in CCC Intelligent Solutions (CCC): Can Its 8.1% Jump Turn into More Strength? - Yahoo Finance
good.plain: Experts see the stock going up and wonder if it will keep rising.

bad.headline: Halper Sadeh LLC is Investigating Whether CCC Intelligent Solutions Holdings Inc. is Obtaining a Fair Price for Its Shareholders - Business Wire
bad.plain: A law firm is checking if the sale price is fair for shareholders — this could mean the deal isn't good enough.

bad.headline: CCC Intelligent Solutions Holdings Inc. Common Stock (NASDAQ:CCC) Cut to 'Hold' at Truist Financial - MarketBeat
bad.plain: A bank lowered its rating on the stock, saying it's just okay to hold, not a strong buy.

bad.headline: CCC Intelligent Solutions Holdings Inc. Common Stock (NASDAQ:CCC) Stock 12‑Month Price Target Cut to $7.89, Implies 3% Upside - TradingView
bad.plain: Experts now think the stock will only go up a little bit in the next year — not much excitement.

bad.headline: CCC Intelligent Solutions Holdings Inc. Common Stock (NASDAQ:CCC) Shares Gap Up - Here's Why - MarketBeat
bad.plain: The stock jumped suddenly, but this headline doesn't say if it's good or bad long-term — so we skip it as unclear.
